name: task_status
description: Get the status of tasks started in this conversation. Omit task_id to list them all. Tasks report back on their own when they finish or need input, so do not poll.

include_result.description: Append the full result of a finished task.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this long for the task to finish or ask for input.

name: task_send
description: Send a message to a task: an extra instruction or an answer while it runs, or a follow-up that continues a finished task when its kind supports that.

mode.description: next_loop: at the task's next step; queue: after its current work; interrupt: drop what it is doing and handle this first.

name: task_stop
description: Stop a running task. A task you stop does not send a notification.

name: task_restart
description: Run a task again from scratch, optionally with new input. The current run is stopped and its context is discarded.

input.description: New input, in the same shape the task was started with; omit to reuse the original input.
